goal: Every persona scores at least 9/10 on verified core journeys, with no unresolved P1/P2 task blockers.

anchors.2: Predictable behavior and safe recovery are verified

anchors.0: Labels and concepts obscure the next step

anchors.1: Progress, failure and recovery are timely and actionable

evidence_policy.critical_native_behavior_requires: Current native verification or clearly identified applicable user verification; a mock does not prove OS integration.
evidence_policy.scoring: Record measured/observed behavior separately from reviewer judgment. Missing evidence remains pending. Do not raise scores merely because fixes landed.
evidence_policy.release_gate: Fixes must be independently reviewed, relevant checks pass, and deployed behavior verified before declaring the goal achieved.
restrictions: No user-file changes or permission resets
Coordinate release/version ownership with the existing release peer

personas.name: 김영희
personas.context: 컴퓨터 설정에 익숙하지 않은 Mac 사용자
personas.goal: 처음 설치하고 가족의 Mac 화면에 연결하기
journeys: 실패 이유 이해와 기본 화면 공유 복구

observed: fixture-browser: fresh state opens onboarding; Mac step shows System Settings mock with Screen Sharing highlighted; '주변 Mac 찾기' → Nearby lists fixture '엄마의 iMac' → 추가 opens editor prefilled with name+address, Mac kind, short-name hint 'Apple ID 아님' (04-add-mac.png).

fixture-browser: error dialogs for auth/refused/timeout/reset are specific, name the device, give System Settings paths and offer 암호 다시 입력 / 다시 시도 / 연결 편집 / 해결 방법 보기 (05-error-*.png). 'other' is generic but points to 설정 → 로그.
fixture-browser: at 800×600 with zoom 175% no horizontal scroll (08-small.png).
fixture-browser: onboarding modal has no role=dialog/aria-modal/aria-labelledby; initial focus stays on <body>; first Tab lands on sidebar '모든 연결' behind the modal.
fixture-browser: editor inputs f-name, f-host, f-account, f-user, f-pass have no programmatic label (label elements lack for=); password reveal buttons are tabindex=-1.
baseline_assessment.judgment: Within one LAN, a novice can probably finish with the guided path if the family Mac was set up by someone in person and they know its short account name (the only in-product way to learn it is `whoami` in Terminal, or Itda installed on that Mac). Reaching a family Mac in another home needs Tailscale on both machines plus account sign-in, which this persona is unlikely to manage alone. Error copy is a strength.
verification_gaps: Download → unzip → move to Applications → first launch (Gatekeeper/notarization) on a clean Mac
macOS Local Network prompt: what happens after Allow and after Don't Allow (Nearby empty? connect = unreachable?)
Real Apple Screen Sharing connection: auth, Remote Management variant, lockout after repeated failures
Permission helper with real TCC (screen recording/accessibility restart flow); only the mocked e2e passed
Remote family case over Tailscale end to end
VoiceOver reading of onboarding/editor/error dialogs

personas.name: 김하늘
personas.context: 앱 설치 없이 휴대폰으로 기기에 접근하는 사용자

observed: fixture-browser (390×844 iPhone UA, touch): login → wrong PIN 'PIN이 맞지 않습니다' → after 5 wrong '잠시 후 다시 시도하세요 (PIN을 여러 번 틀렸습니다)' with no duration → correct PIN → list with iOS add-to-home hint (p01-p03).
fixture-browser: login copy says 'Windows PC의 Itda 설정 → ‘다른 기기에서 보기’에 표시된 6자리 PIN', but the PIN is on the 공유 page and the gateway can also be a Mac (web/viewer/index.html:22).
fixture-browser: host without password: card text '암호를 저장해야 열 수 있습니다 — 눌러서 입력' is cut to '암호를 저장해야 열 수 있습니ㄴ' at 390px; tapping opens the editor with a note and kind-specific hint (p03, p04).
fixture-browser: close codes 4012/4010/4013/1006 show title + advice + 목록으로/다시 연결 only; for Mac 4010 the advice is generic ('저장된 사용자 이름과 암호를 확인하세요'); title grammar 'Mac이(가)' (p05-*).
fixture-browser: viewing toolbar has 9 icon-only 42×40 buttons; toolbar scrollWidth 420 > clientWidth 372, so '전체 화면' sits at x 383–425 past the 390px screen with a hidden scrollbar (p06-tools.png).
fixture-browser: touch targets under 44px on list: refresh 36×36, edit pencils 34×34, tabs 60×35, hint close 26×36.
fixture-browser: after the session is gone, '목록으로' drops to the login screen with an empty message (p07-expired.png).

source: gateway cookie HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; 12h TTL; same-origin check on POST/WS; per-source 5-fail/1-min lockout plus a global 50-fail lock (src/gateway.rs:33,412-479). Transport is plain HTTP on the LAN unless Tailscale HTTPS is used (documented in-app).
baseline_assessment.judgment: With fixtures the browser flow is short and the PIN/session handling is sound. Comprehension and recovery are the weak spots: the first screen points to the wrong place, auth failures have no 'fix password' route, and controls are icon-only with tooltips that touch devices never show. Phone access also needs a computer running Itda on the same network and kept awake. The landing page shows phone visitors only Windows/Mac download buttons.
verification_gaps: Real iOS Safari and Android Chrome: QR camera hand-off, PIN keypad, add-to-home/PWA standalone
noVNC touch gestures on device (tap, two-finger tap right-click, two-finger scroll, pinch toggling fit)

Korean IME on iOS/Android through the hidden textarea, esp. to a Mac on Apple Screen Sharing (Unicode keysyms 0x0100xxxx; Itda's own servers handle them in src/host_mac.rs:827 and src/keys.rs:89, Apple's server unverified) — docs promise '한글 가능'
Clipboard sheet copy on iOS (navigator.clipboard over plain HTTP falls back to select)
Behavior when PIN is reset or web viewer stopped while a phone is mid-session
Tailscale HTTPS address end to end
